author: Trent Jonas
title: This Hidden Beach in Ohio Is Better Than the Popular One - NewsBreak
text:
By Trent Jonas ,
1 hours ago
There’s no denying that the Buckeye State is blessed with beaches, especially along its often-sandy Lake Erie shoreline. In the northeast part of the state, where a large portion of the population lives, many of the best beaches in Ohio, like popular Headlands Beach, can get really crowded, especially on summer weekends. If you’re willing to travel a little farther east, however, you’ll find Breakwater Beach, an almost hidden beach in Ohio that offers a much less-crowded alternative to Headlands.
Why Headlands Beach Gets So Crowded Photo by Tom Gill via Flickr Creative Commons Headlands Beach, located within the state park that shares its name, is Ohio’s longest natural sand beach, and many would consider this half-mile strand one of the best beaches in the U.S. It’s adjacent to the town of Mentor, which puts it within easy reach of the greater Cleveland area. The park itself is also home to an iconic, red-roofed lighthouse, which is also a popular destination among the area’s visitors. These factors, combined with the park’s amenities and numerous nearby options for dining, shopping, and entertainment, make Headlands Beach one of the most popular beaches in Ohio.
The Beach You Should Visit Instead Photo by Dominic Salvucci via Flickr Creative Commons Travel just half an hour (or so) east of Headlands Beach, and you’ll encounter Geneva State Park , which is home to one of the more overlooked hidden gems in Ohio : Breakwater Beach. It’s a beautiful, 600-foot crescent of sand stretching between two stone breakwalls, the longer of which protects the entrance to the park’s marina. The inland side of the beach is forested with mature trees, so you’ll enjoy wind protection from both the south and the east—and you can find a spot of shade if you need a break from the sun. Given its location and amenities, Breakwater Beach is one of the best Headlands Beach alternatives in Ohio.
What Makes This Beach Better Photo by Dominic Salvucci via Flickr Creative Commons Like Headlands Beach, Breakwater Beach lies within a state park, so it’s free to access, park your vehicle, and use the facilities, which include restrooms and showers. The biggest difference is that when you go to the beach at Geneva State Park or try to use its facilities, you’ll find far fewer people with the same idea, making Breakwater one of the more underrated beaches in Ohio. There’s even a dog-friendly end of the beach outside the designated swimming area, so you can bring along your fur baby on your beach day. Breakwater is easily one of the best beaches in Ohio .
Is It Worth Skipping Headlands Beach? Photo by Mark Cameron via Flickr Creative Commons Is it worth skipping Headlands Beach and going to Geneva State Park in Ohio instead? If you’re like me and prefer your doses of nature with fewer crowds, then definitely. Although it’s a different scene with a lower-key vibe, Breakwater Beach offers the same kind of sandy strand with turquoise Lake Erie views that you’ll find at Headlands. It’s also immediately adjacent to the bustling beach community of Geneva-on-the-Lake , so you can enjoy a day on this wide, practically hidden beach in Ohio, then head into town to find the types of dining and entertainment options you’d expect to see near a much busier beach. It’s the best of both worlds.
